login.title: Sign in to AnyLearn
login.subtitle: Use the account you already have. AnyLearn never asks for a password.
login.noProviders: No sign-in method is configured yet. The administrator must set OAuth credentials.
login.footer: By signing in you agree that AnyLearn stores the documents you add and the AI accounts you connect.
login.localNote: Signs you in as the one local account on this machine. Only offered on localhost with ANYTOOLS_DEV_LOGIN=1; a server never shows it.

errors.emailTaken: This email already has an AnyLearn account created with a different sign-in method. Sign in that way instead, then link this one from Settings.
errors.emailUnverified: That provider did not confirm your email address. Verify it with the provider, then try again.
errors.stateMismatch: That sign-in link expired or was opened in a different browser. Please start again.
errors.exchangeFailed: We could not complete sign-in with that provider. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: That sign-in method is not configured on this server.
errors.generic: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
